name: locivoire-app
description: Application mobile Locivoire (App Store & Play Store)

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug
